businessObject: AI Agent Usage Summary Dashboard (analytics/reporting interface)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a user navigates to the dashboard, When the page loads, Then the 4 KPI cards must render with data
Given the region breakdown table is displayed, When the data is populated, Then the rows must be sorted by Interaction Count in descending order
Given the user views the capabilities list, When the data is populated, Then it must display exactly the top 5 capabilities ranked by usage count
Given the user views the users list, When the data is populated, Then it must display exactly the top 5 users ranked by interaction count

Given the user selects a combination of filters (e.g., "LATAM" and "Facilities Support"), When the resulting data is empty, Then the affected components must display a "No data available" message instead of a generic error or 0
Given the user interacts with the UI, When they apply a filter, Then all applicable components on the page must re-fetch and update to reflect the filtered context

HP.description: User navigates to dashboard → page loads → all 4 KPI cards render with aggregated data
User views region breakdown table → rows are sorted by Interaction Count descending
User views capabilities list → exactly top 5 capabilities displayed, ranked by usage count
User views users list → exactly top 5 users displayed, ranked by interaction count
User applies a single filter (e.g., Region = "APAC") → all components re-fetch and update with filtered data
User applies multiple filters (e.g., Timeframe = "60-day", Region = "EMEA", Capability = "Desk Booking") → all components re-fetch and update with filtered data

AP.description: User applies filter combinations sequentially (e.g., first Region, then Capability, then Timeframe) → all components update correctly after each change

NEG.description: User selects filter combination that yields zero results (e.g., "LATAM" + "Facilities Support" with no data) → affected components display "No data available" message

EDGE.description: Database contains fewer than 5 capabilities → capabilities list displays all available (e.g., 3 items) without error
Database contains fewer than 5 users → users list displays all available (e.g., 2 items) without error
Multiple capabilities have identical usage counts → system applies deterministic tie-breaking (e.g., alphabetical order) for consistent ranking
Multiple users have identical interaction counts → system applies deterministic tie-breaking (e.g., alphabetical by user ID) for consistent ranking
All regions have zero interactions → region breakdown table displays "No data available"
All capabilities have zero usage → capabilities list displays "No data available"
All users have zero interactions → users list displays "No data available"

input.name: region
input.label: Region Dropdown
input.validRange: APAC, EMEA, AMER, LATAM, All Regions (defaults to All Regions)

input.name: capability
input.label: Capability Dropdown
input.validRange: Desk Booking, Facilities Support, All Capabilities (defaults to All Capabilities)
